name: Organostab
description: A complex polypharmaceutical compound designed to maintain the biochemical environment required for synthetic organ function — addressing the unique metabolic needs of lab-grown or fully synthetic hearts, lungs, kidneys, and livers that have replaced organic equivalents. Synthetic organs require a different internal chemical milieu than biological ones; Organostab provides the enzyme cofactors, pH buffers, and anti-fouling agents that keep them running at specification. Missing doses causes synthetic organ performance degradation within days.
effects: prevents membrane fouling in synthetic filtration organs
supplies cofactors for synthetic metabolic processes
extends functional lifespan of synthetic organs
supports immune tolerance at organ-tissue interfaces
side_effects: digestive disruption if taken without food
urine discoloration from clearance of organ maintenance byproducts
taste disturbance — persistent metallic taste in some users
interaction with alcohol can reduce efficacy
rare: synthetic organ rejection if formulation mismatches organ make/model
street_price: Φ50–Φ200 per month depending on organ count
cultural_context: People with synthetic organs — whether from injury, disease, or elective replacement — live on Organostab. Lazarus has engineered a degree of organ-formulation dependency: their synthetic hearts work best with Lazarus-brand Organostab, creating captive patient populations. This is an open secret and a source of persistent legislative battles that Lazarus continues to win. On the Shelf, people with synthetic organs and no prescription access buy whatever gray-market formulation they can find and hope it's close enough.
story_hooks: Lazarus has quietly updated their synthetic heart firmware to require a new Organostab formulation, effectively forcing thousands of patients onto a more expensive subscription — and someone has documented this as deliberate planned obsolescence.
A Shelf medic has figured out how to synthesize a functional Organostab equivalent from available precursors — Lazarus's legal division has noticed and is moving to shut her down.

A character discovers that their synthetic kidney's maintenance requirements have been subtly altered in their medical records, meaning they've been taking the wrong Organostab formulation for months — and someone did it deliberately.
